messages.subject: version 0.4.2 released
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

Minor changes from 0.4.1.  There was a stray browser() left in one of the utility functions of the package.

Should be up on CRAN in the next few days.  For the impatient, I've uploaded the new version on http://code.google.com/p/rexcel/

Best,

Adrian
